from __future__ import annotations

from orders.infrastructure.stock import InMemoryStockRepository


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Api:
    customers: CustomerController
    catalog: CatalogController
    orders: OrderController
    reports: ReportsController


def build_app() -> Api:

    customers = InMemoryCustomerRepository()

    stock = InMemoryStockRepository()

        customers=CustomerController(CustomerService(customers)),
        catalog=CatalogController(CatalogService(catalog, stock)),
        orders=OrderController(OrderService(orders, customers, catalog, stock)),
        reports=ReportsController(orders),

28	        "customer_id": order.customer_id,
29	        "status": order.status,
30	        "items": [{"sku": i.sku, "quantity": i.quantity, "unit_price_cents": i.unit_price_cents}
31	                  for i in order.items],

5	from typing import Any

7	from orders.application.errors import Conflict, OrderNotFound, ProductNotFound
8	from orders.infrastructure.catalog import InMemoryProductCatalog
9	from orders.infrastructure.customers import InMemoryCustomerRepository

12	
13	
14	class FulfilmentService:
15	    def __init__(
16	        self,
17	        orders: InMemoryOrderRepository,
18	        customers: InMemoryCustomerRepository,
19	        catalog: InMemoryProductCatalog,
20	        stock: InMemoryStockRepository,
21	    ) -> None:
22	        self._orders = orders
23	        self._customers = customers
24	        self._catalog = catalog
25	        self._stock = stock
26	
27	    def get_packing_slip(self, order_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
28	        order = self._orders.get(order_id)
29	        if order is None:
30	            raise OrderNotFound(order_id)
31	        if order.status == "cancelled":
32	            raise Conflict("cannot pack a cancelled order")
33	        customer = self._customers.get(order.customer_id)
34	        lines = []
35	        for item in order.items:
36	            product = self._catalog.get(item.sku)
37	            lines.append({
38	                "sku": item.sku,
39	                "name": product.name if product else item.sku,
40	                "quantity": item.quantity,
41	            })
42	        return {
43	            "order_id": order.order_id,
44	            "customer_name": customer.name if customer else "",
45	            "lines": lines,
46	        }
47	
48	    def get_low_stock_products(self, threshold: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
49	        products = []
50	        for product in self._catalog.list_all():
51	            if product.active and self._stock.get(product.sku) < threshold:
52	                products.append({
53	                    "sku": product.sku,
54	                    "name": product.name,
55	                    "on_hand": self._stock.get(product.sku),
56	                })
57	        products.sort(key=lambda p: (p["on_hand"], p["sku"]))
58	        return {"products": products}
59	
60	    def restock(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
61	        if self._catalog.get(sku) is None:
62	            raise ProductNotFound(sku)

64	        self._stock.set(sku, new_level)
65	        return {"sku": sku, "on_hand": new_level}
